jobs.title: Technical Customer Support
jobs.description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. W

jobs.title: PhD Position: World Models for Software Architecture Synthesis (Constructor Fabric)
jobs.description: <p><strong>Supervisor: </strong>Prof. Dr. Alexander Tormasov<strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Position</strong></p> <p>Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL), in collaboration with Constructor Technology, invites applications for a PhD position in machine learning for software engineering and formal methods, on the Constructor Fabric project.</p> <p>Constructor Fabric turns a company's informal knowledge into production software through a pipeline of composable capability units called <em>gears</em>: requirements → architecture → product fit → framework (G1) → application → runtime. We are building a <strong>World Model</strong> over that pipeline — a model that does not just generate code, but predicts the <em>consequences</em> of an architectural decision: total cost of ownership, unintended side effects, latency and failure behaviour, and whether a proposed composition is even admissible.</p> <p><br>The central object is not a digital twin of the application but its <strong>formal architectural skeleton</strong>: gear contracts (GearSpec), a typed attributed hypergraph of the application (AppGraph), a composition algebra that defines which assemblies are legal, and several semantic projections (types, protocols, resources, security) over which properties are proved, refuted by counterexample, or reported as an explainable <strong>gap</strong>. All of it is written in a <strong>domain-specific language</strong> whose syntax trees and graphs we keep in a projectional editor (JetBrains MPS) — so the DSL is not a convenience layer, it is the thing that defines the model's state space and the boundary of what the model is allowed to propose.</p> <p><strong>What you will work on</strong><br>Depending on your background, one or two of:</p> <ol> <li>Formal skeleton and composition — GearSpec as a contract $(Requires, Provides, State, Effects, Assumptions, Guarantees, Parameters)$; AppGraph as a typed attributed hypergraph; an algebra of assembly (sequential, parallel, feedback, refinement); semantic projections and system-level invariants over trajectories.</li> <li>Architecture synthesis as an inverse problem — given a specification, load and constraints, find the composition of gears that realises it. Constraint solving and MCTS as the baseline; a learned transition/value model for ranking and pruning; LLM proposals treated strictly as candidate hypotheses that a DSL parser, type checker and property checks must then admit or reject.</li> <li>DSL design and language engineering — the gear DSL and its glue layer decide which AppGraphs are expressible at all, and therefore where the search space ends. This thread covers the abstract syntax and static semantics of that DSL; the requirement that an architectural decision be unbypassable by construction (you must not be able to wire authentication around the Auth Resolver); what happens to the language when gear contracts change or a 201st gear is added; projectional representation of graphs with cycles; and the open hypothesis that a specialised G1-DSL is generated together with every G1.</li> <li>Local transition models and pipeline surrogates — fast approximate predictors for single pipeline steps (spec change → code quality, architecture → product fit, app → runtime outcome), with calibrated uncertainty, validated against real telemetry.</li> <li>Data — reconstructing (specification → architecture) pairs from open repositories at scale, plus synthetic project generation from a fixed gear set and DSL grammar to cover rare transitions, gaps and counterexamples.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>MSc (or equivalent) in computer science, mathematics,

You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.</p> <h2>What you will do</h2> <ul> <li>Design and build platform services, jobs.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Bring VPN and Personal Information Removal into the browser through the DuckDuckGo subscription. Catch startup and responsiveness regressions automatically, so the browser stays fast as it grows. As a Senior C++/Chromium Engineer, you'll lead complex projects from proposal through post-mortem. You'll turn vague problems into clear plans, build them in a large modern C++ codebase, and use metrics to show they worked. Some days that means low-level systems work. Others, it means architecture decisions the whole team builds on. You'll collaborate with design and product, mostly asynchronously, to build features people use to protect their privacy. Secure data catalogue and access-control platform A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld. Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing. jobs.description: About Customs Support Group Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency.   The Role You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market. This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end. You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences. Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions. Key Responsibilities • Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership. • Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business • Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building. • Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit. • Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought. • Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it. • Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact. • Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners. • Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it. . Not familiarity. • Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully. • Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex). • Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is • Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI. • Professional fluency in English. jobs.title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
jobs.description: We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights .   About CXG: Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide. The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact. Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction. We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality. Context and role Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals. This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member. Thought Leadership Development Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar. Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions. Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to: Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects. Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap. Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation. Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence. Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality. Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets. Thought Leadership Communication Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis. Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market. Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap. Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content

jobs.description: Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe The mission At Lucis , we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here . The role Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end. With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead . You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team. What you will own Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency. Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member. Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself. Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams. Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI. About you You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do. You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger. You’ll fit in well if Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too. Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken. People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences. Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care. Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket. Nice to have Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools. AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work. Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication. The process Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min) Case study interview (30-60 min) Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours) Reference calls How we work We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis. Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar. Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis. jobs.description: About Morpho Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world. Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here . Location: Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team). About the role: As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem. Responsibilities: Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security. Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security. Oversight of the IT function Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales. Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation. Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event. Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels. Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably. Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives. Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence. jobs.description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management. We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently. As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A , Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) , and Procurement . This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO . ✨ Why this role is special Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. jobs.description: The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase: Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure. Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model: Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware. Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down. Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases. Investigate and resolve performance, reliability, and usability issues in the stack raised by the team and reduce their recurrence through shared tooling. Solid PyTorch knowledge and practical experience with model training and profiling (required). Experience running ML workloads on a cloud platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, IAM, storage), and with containerization (required). Experience taking models to production: model packaging, inference serving, and performance and reliability constraints (required). Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required). Ability to work autonomously in a distributed, multi-site team, with clear verbal and written communication in English (required). En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu. La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections. Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux. La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer. Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients. La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients. Atouts Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp. Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. jobs.title: Chef d'équipe logistique (H/F)
jobs.description: <h2>En bref</h2> <p>Picnic grandit vite, et notre centre de préparation de commandes de Moissy-Cramayel a besoin de pilotes pour porter cette ambition. En tant que Captain, tu n'es pas juste un(e) chef(fe) d'équipe : tu es le moteur de l'entrepôt. Ton défi ? Manager environ 20 Shoppers (préparateur(rice)s de commandes) en direct, garantir une sécurité totale et transformer chaque shift en succès collectif avec +100 Shoppers sur le terrain. Si tu aimes l'action et que tu sais fédérer une équipe dans la bonne humeur, ce rôle est pour toi.</p> <h2>Tes missions</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Manager et coacher ton équipe</strong> : Tu supervises une vingtaine de Shoppers au quotidien, en veillant à leur motivation, leur sécurité et au respect des bonnes pratiques.</li> <li><strong>Piloter la performance</strong> : Tu garantis que chaque commande est prête, complète et à l'heure, en suivant de près nos indicateurs de qualité.</li> <li><strong>Coordonner les flux du FC</strong> : Tu travailles main dans la main avec les autres Captains pour fluidifier les opérations et ajuster les ressources en temps réel.</li> <li><strong>Assurer la polyvalence opérationnelle</strong> : Réception, gestion des stocks (sec, frais, surgelé) ou départ des camions... tu navigues entre les zones selon les besoins du planning.</li> <li><strong>Gérer l'humain et le terrain</strong> : Tu es le point de contact privilégié pour ton équipe, capable de recadrer avec pédagogie comme de féliciter les réussites.</li> </ul> <h2>À propos de toi</h2> <ul> <li>Tu as entre 1 et 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement dynamique (logistique, retail, restauration ou ligne de production) avec une première gestion d'équipe réussie.</li> <li>Tu es disponible à temps plein sur des shifts tournants (matin dès 3h50 ou après-midi jusqu'à 23h30) et tu es prêt(e) à travailler les samedis.&nbsp;</li> <li>Tu maîtrises le français (l'anglais est un plus) et tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les outils digitaux de pilotage.</li> <li>Tu es véhiculé(e) pour rejoindre facilement l'entrepôt de Moissy-Cramayel.</li> <li>Tu n'as pas peur de mettre la main à la pâte. Tu aimes l'action et tu sais prendre des décisions rapides pour débloquer des situations opérationnelles.</li> </ul> <h2>Avantages Picnic&nbsp;</h2> <p>🍴 <strong>Restauration&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Dans ton FC, tu disposeras d’une variété de déjeuners, de dîners, de snacks et de boissons sains, préparés fraîchement sur place par notre chef !</p> <p><strong>🎫 Sorties et divertissement</strong></p> <p>Un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu seras aussi convié(e) à nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party !</p> <p><strong>👨‍⚕️ Santé et repos</strong></p> <p>Grâce à nos partenariats avec SideCare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, tu disposeras de 25 jours de congés payés par an.</p> <p><strong>✍️ Développement personnel et professionnel</strong></p> <p>Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à des formations dédiées au leadership.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/FSwRUFqnISA" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p&gt

parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Expérience avérée dans la direction et le développement d'équipes jobs.description: <h1>Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)&nbsp;</h1> <p>Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées</p> <h2>À propos de l’opportunité</h2> <p>Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.</p> <p>En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.</p> <p>Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.</p> </li> <li> <p>Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.</p> </li> <li> <p>Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.</p> </li> <li> <p>Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous recherchons</h2> <h3>Indispensable</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.</p> </li> <li> <p>Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons

jobs.title: Young Graduate in Data and Software Engineering (Zurich, Switzerland)
jobs.description: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations. Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. Requirements What You’ll Do Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision. As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it. In general you will: use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation; use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure; participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance; Are You the team member we are looking for? In order to be successful in this role, you are/have: motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering comfortable interacting with technical and business people strong communication and presentation skills recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major; familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git) familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s) fluent in both English and German available for a minimum of 32h a week. ready to start on the 1st of February Benefits What We Offer Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor 15 paid days of holiday Be part of an international team of more than 20 nationalities. up to 10% of paid time for self-development. Flexible working hours, including some home office. Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites. If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position. jobs.title: Process Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Functieprofiel Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software). Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners. Bedrijfsomschrijving NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie. Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste. Wat ga jij doen! In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met: Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3) Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein Wat wij vragen! Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering: Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen Wat bieden wij jou! Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd. Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities. Daarnaast: In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses Mogelijkheden voor remote support Geïnteresseerd!  Solliciteer dan snel via onze website. Wil je eerst meer informatie over de functie en organisatie? Mail dan naar Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Role summary Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. Responsibilities Product vision, grounded in real user needs You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. Market scoping and opportunity-spotting Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. Logistics know-how turned into product decisions   Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. The full lifecycle From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. The connective tissue across the company   When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. The team you’ll join You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. Life at Bluerock We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock. 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required. Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required. A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations , on time and within budget. Genuine ease operating cross-functionally . You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission. An appetite for ambiguity and change : a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem. Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification. Excellent leadership and team management skills , with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively. Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment Our hiring process Hit the Apply button. Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation. An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS. jobs.description: Cordaan biedt zorg binnen en buiten Amsterdam aan en wil zich onderscheiden als leerbedrijf. Wij hebben voor diverse beroepsopleidingen in de zorg een stageplek op maat. Dus ook voor jou!  Er is veel aandacht voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en we zorgen voor een gedegen begeleiding. Na je sollicitatie zoeken we samen met het opleidingsbureau naar de beste stageplek. Overigens vinden wij het niet alleen belangrijk dat jij leert van ons, wij willen ook leren van jou! Als student breng je tenslotte ook kennis, vaardigheden en nieuwe inzichten mee en daarmee doen wij ons voordeel. Zo werkt het twee kanten op. Je kan met deze vraag het beste contact opnemen met een vrijwilligerscoördinator. Ga naar https://www.cordaan.nl/vrijwilligers of neem contact op met het servicepunt informele zorg via Bij Cordaan krijgt iedereen de kans om tot bloei te komen. Ben je onder de 40? jobs.title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht? Word jij blij van de afwisseling en uitdaging van een projectmatige rol en met de zekerheid en voordelen van een baan in loondienst? Dan is deze rol als interim manager bij Cordaan iets voor jou!   Wat ga je doen?   Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden.  Jouw belangrijkste taken:  Leidinggeven in complexe situaties: Je biedt duidelijkheid, hakt knopen door en creëert een veilige en gestructureerde werkomgeving.  Verandermanagement: Je begeleidt afdelingen in transitie en zorgt voor blijvende verbeteringen in zorgkwaliteit en teamdynamiek.  Bedrijfsvoering op orde brengen: Je monitort en rapporteert maandelijks over financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid en verloop.  Samenwerking versterken: Je betrekt vrijwilligers, mantelzorgers en familieleden bij het welzijn van cliënten.  Coachen en inspireren: Je helpt de collega’s op de locatie groeien, zodat zij hun werk met plezier en vertrouwen kunnen doen.  Wat krijg je van ons?   Bij Cordaan krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao VVT:  Een jaarcontract ( 32 - 36 uur per week ) met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;  Salaris conform CAO VVT FWG 60: min. € 4.157 en max. € 6.171 bruto  (o.b.v. 36 uur per week);  Extra’s : Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%);  Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan;  Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;    Ontwikkelmogelijkheden : Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen;   Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto. Wie ben jij?   Jij bent een manager met een sterke persoonlijkheid en ruime ervaring in crisis- en verandermanagement in de zorg. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Recruiter die recruitment écht beheerst. Iemand die begrijpt dat een vacature online zetten het begin is en niet de strategie. Je weet hoe je zelf de markt in gaat. Je searcht, sourcet, benadert en bouwt relaties op. Je probeert verschillende invalshoeken als een search niet werkt. Je kent LinkedIn Recruiter, maar weet ook dat sourcing meer is dan een paar zoektermen invoeren en InMails versturen. En misschien nog belangrijker: je hebt ideeën. Over waar we talent kunnen vinden. Over hoe we mensen kunnen benaderen. Over employer branding. Over onze propositie als werkgever. Over tooling, data, events, referrals, communities en alles wat ons kan helpen om betere mensen aan adesso te verbinden. Zie je een kans? Dan verwachten we niet dat je wacht tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je pakt hem. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid voor recruitment binnen adesso Nederland en werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en management. Daarbij ben je zowel strategisch als operationeel. Want senior zijn betekent bij ons niet dat je alleen adviseert. Je doet het ook zelf. Je: voert zelfstandig searches uit naar schaarse IT-professionals; bouwt talentpools op in plaats van pas te zoeken zodra er een vacature ontstaat; benadert kandidaten persoonlijk en weet hun interesse te wekken; experimenteert met nieuwe sourcingkanalen en manieren van benaderen; voert intakes met hiring managers en durft kritisch te zijn op het profiel dat zij zoeken; adviseert over haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, salaris en recruitmentstrategie; voert gesprekken met kandidaten en begeleidt het proces van eerste contact tot hire; houdt overzicht over je vacatures en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat; gebruikt data om te begrijpen wat wel en niet werkt; komt zelf met voorstellen om recruitment slimmer en effectiever te maken; denkt mee over employer branding, referral recruitment, events en communities; bouwt mee aan hoe recruitment binnen adesso Nederland zich verder ontwikkelt. Je krijgt daarbij geen dichtgetimmerd recruitmenthandboek. We verwachten juist dat jij vanuit je ervaring kunt zeggen: “Dit werkt niet. Ik denk dat we het zo moeten aanpakken.” En vervolgens help je om het te realiseren. Wanneer ben je voor ons senior? Niet omdat er ‘Senior Recruiter’ op je LinkedIn-profiel staat. Voor ons zit senioriteit in hoe je werkt. Je hoeft niet gevraagd te worden om te sourcen je weet dat het onderdeel van je vak is. Als een search niets oplevert, concludeer je niet dat “de markt lastig is”. Je verandert je aanpak. Als een hiring manager een onrealistisch profiel zoekt, durf je dat gesprek te voeren. Als je ziet dat ons recruitmentproces beter kan, kom je niet alleen met het probleem maar ook met een voorstel. En als je een goed idee hebt, krijg je energie van het daadwerkelijk uitvoeren ervan. We zoeken iemand met stevige recruitmentervaring, bij voorkeur binnen IT, tech of consultancy. Maar het aantal jaren ervaring vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je daadwerkelijk kunt. We willen vooral zien dat je: aantoonbaar sterk bent in search, sourcing en direct benaderen; weet hoe je schaarse senior professionals vindt en interesseert; verschillende sourcingstrategieën kunt bedenken én uitvoeren; creatief bent in het vinden van nieuwe kandidaten en doelgroepen; verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je vacatures en resultaten; zelfstandig prioriteiten stelt; hiring managers als volwaardig gesprekspartner adviseert; kritisch durft te zijn wanneer dat nodig is; nieuwsgierig bent naar nieuwe recruitmenttechnieken, tooling en AI; met data naar je eigen recruitmentfunnel kijkt; ideeën niet alleen bedenkt, maar ook uitvoert; Nederlands en Engels professioneel beheerst. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Bouw dataplatformen die klaar zijn voor wat er morgen met data en AI gebeurt. Bij adesso zoeken we een Data Engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen het bouwen van pipelines. Je werkt aan dataplatformen die organisaties daadwerkelijk gebruiken. Als basis voor reporting en analytics, maar steeds vaker ook voor machine learning, AI en agentic toepassingen. Jouw rol Als Data Engineer ontwerp en bouw je schaalbare data-oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je werkt aan het hele traject: van databron en architectuur tot een betrouwbaar platform waarop data daadwerkelijk gebruikt kan worden. Je begrijpt waarom bepaalde keuzes worden gemaakt, kunt hierover sparren met klanten en collega's en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van de oplossing. Wat ga je doen? ·       Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van schaalbare data pipelines en dataplatformen; ·       Ontwikkelen van cloud-native data-oplossingen; ·       Integreren, transformeren en ontsluiten van data uit verschillende bronnen; ·       Ontwerpen en implementeren van moderne Data Warehouse- en Lakehouse-architecturen; ·       Toepassen van datamodelleringsmethodieken zoals Kimball en Data Vault; ·       Bouwen van betrouwbare datasets voor analytics, dashboards, machine learning en AI-toepassingen; ·       Werken met technologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory en Snowflake; ·       Optimaliseren van performance, schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en datakwaliteit; ·       Inrichten en verbeteren van CI/CD-processen en toepassen van DataOps-principes; ·       Meedenken met klanten over data-architectuur, integraties en technische keuzes; ·       Samenwerken met Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Architects en andere specialisten binnen ons Data & AI-team. We zoeken niet iemand die ieder vinkje op een technologielijst kan zetten. We zoeken vooral een Data Engineer die een stevig technisch fundament heeft, nieuwsgierig blijft en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor wat hij of zij bouwt. Je hebt: ·       Minimaal 4 jaar relevante ervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol; ·       Sterke kennis van SQL en Python; ·       Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van ETL/ELT-processen en data pipelines; ·       Ervaring met Microsoft Azure en relevante Azure-datadiensten, zoals Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake; ·       Ervaring met datamodellering en moderne data-architecturen, bijvoorbeeld Kimball en Data Vault; ·       Kennis van Data Warehouse- en/of Lakehouse-concepten; ·       Ervaring met CI/CD, DevOps en bij voorkeur Infrastructure as Code; ·       Oog voor datakwaliteit, performance, schaalbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid; ·       Het vermogen om technische keuzes uit te leggen en hierover met klanten en collega's te sparren; ·       Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand. That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish : from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team . Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn. This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployments and internal tooling. With Malte and our product team, you turn what you see in hospitals into clear requirements. In hospital projects, you work hand in hand with our customer success and sales team and on the hospital side with IT leads, KIS vendors, coders and medical controlling. What you will do Bring hospitals live: You take hospitals from sandbox to production, deploy Valova on hospital VMs and connect it to KIS systems such as SAP i.s.h.med, Orbis or Dedalus. Build the connections: You build and maintain interfaces (HL7, FHIR, archive and document exports) together with hospital IT and their partners. Set up Valova for each customer: You configure document types, case filtering, department rules and coding workflows. Learn from the ward: You work on site with coders and medical controlling and turn their friction into clear product requirements. Make deployments repeatable: You write the code that makes the next go-live faster: connectors, scripts, monitoring and internal tooling. Earn the hospital’s trust: You answer technical questions in security and data protection reviews (BSI C5, GDPR). What we are looking for: Engineering experience: At least two years in software engineering, and you’re comfortable with Linux, Docker and basic networking. Integration know-how: You’ve worked on system integrations. Experience with HL7/FHIR or SAP environments is a big plus. Customer focus: You enjoy working with customers and explain technical topics clearly to IT leads and coders alike. High ownership: You move things forward, even when three parties are involved. Travel: You’re happy to spend around 30 percent of your time at hospitals across Germany. Languages: You speak fluent German and English, since our customers work in German. Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin. Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you! jobs.title: Business Development & Sales Intern (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über Valova Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann. Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben . Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang . Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses , bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin . Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Warum diese Rolle zählt Als Praktikant:in im Business Development & Sales sorgst Du dafür, dass unser Vertriebsteam seine Zeit mit den richtigen Kliniken verbringt. Du findest und qualifizierst die Accounts, eröffnest die ersten Gespräche und buchst die Demos, die dann unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen wahrnehmen. Gleichzeitig baust Du den Motor dahinter mit auf: saubere Daten in unserem CRM Tool, Outreach-Sequenzen, die laufen, Dashboards, die zeigen, wo wir stehen, und KI-Automatisierungen, die unserem Team jede Woche Stunden sparen. Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du direkt anhand der gebuchten Termine, einer aufgebauten Pipeline und Prozessen, die weiterlaufen, lange nachdem Du sie aufgesetzt hast. Du sitzt nicht in der zweiten Reihe und schaust zu. Du baust den Vertriebsmotor mit auf, der Valova in Kliniken in ganz Deutschland bringt. Deine Rolle im Team Du berichtest an unseren VP Sales und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Regional Sales Manager:innen im Norden und Süden zusammen. Für viele Kliniken bist Du der erste Kontakt: Du recherchierst Accounts, gehst Inbound Leads nach, sprichst Entscheider:innen per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an und übergibst qualifizierte Termine an die Regional Sales Manager:innen, die sie bis zur Unterschrift bringen. Neben dem Outreach unterstützt du RevOps & Enablement, einen Bereich, den aktuell unser VP Sales selbst führt und gestaltest so von innen mit, wie unser Vertrieb arbeitet. Eng zusammen arbeitest Du außerdem mit unserem Marketing bei Kampagnen und Events sowie mit unseren Kodierexpert:innen und dem medizinischen Team, um zu verstehen, worauf es Kliniken wirklich ankommt. Deine Aufgaben Türen zu Kliniken öffnen: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Kliniken, von privaten Klinikgruppen über kommunale und ländliche Häuser bis zu Unikliniken, recherchierst die richtigen Entscheider:innen in Geschäftsführung, Finanzen, Medizincontrolling und Kodierung und gehst Inbound Leads schnell nach. Gespräche starten, die zählen: Du sprichst Kliniken per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an, mit Sequenzen, die auf den jeweiligen Kliniktyp und seine Herausforderungen zugeschnitten sind. Qualifizieren und Demos buchen: Du findest heraus, ob echter Bedarf besteht, wer entscheidet und wann und buchst Demos für unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen mit sauberer Übergabe. Unsere Pipeline up-to-date halten: Du hältst unser CRM sauber, baust Dashboards und bereitest Pipeline- und Forecast-Reportings für unseren VP Sales vor. Mit KI automatisieren: Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen für Recherche, Datenanreicherung und Outreach, damit unser Team weniger Zeit mit Routine und mehr Zeit mit Kliniken verbringt. Unseren Vertrieb mitgestalten: Du schreibst SOPs, schärfst Sequenzen und Playbook, unterstützt den Deal Desk bei Angeboten und Business Cases und recherchierst den Klinikmarkt und unseren Wettbewerb. Was Du mitbringst Studium: Du studierst BWL, VWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Gesundheitsökonomie, Medizin oder ein anderes relevantes Feld und suchst ein Vollzeitpraktikum über mindestens sechs Monate. Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits durch ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in Vertrieb, Busine

jobs.title: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security
jobs.description: We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile. When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models. The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role. The work Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently. You'll work on two related areas. Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people. AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. That includes: A provenance chain from training through packaging to deployment, with signatures that can be verified offline on air-gapped robots A model SBOM format, building on CycloneDX's ML-BOM Delta updates between model versions (full models, fine-tunes, LoRA adapters, quantized variants), so robots don't download gigabytes for a small change Compression that combines model techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation) with what package managers already do well (zstd, content-addressable storage), tuned to the target hardware and network Managing models that get fine-tuned on the robot itself: tracking where those variants came from, validating them, and syncing them back Testing the whole pipeline end to end on real models and real hardware, and measuring latency, bandwidth and model quality A lot of this is new. Part of the job is figuring out which approaches work, measuring them honestly, and writing up what you found. What we're looking for You don't need years of experience. You do need solid fundamentals, curiosity, and the patience to get security details right. Rust, or a strong background in C++, Go or Python and the wish to switch Interest in software supply chain security. Bonus if you've worked with Sigstore (Cosign, Rekor, Fulcio), TUF, in-toto, SLSA or SBOM formats Familiarity with ML in practice: you've trained or fine-tuned a model, know what a LoRA adapter or a quantized model is, and have used PyTorch or similar Basic understanding of cryptography as an engineer: signatures, hashes, certificates, and what they do and don't guarantee You like measuring things and are honest about results that don't work out You live in Berlin or are willing to move here It's a plus if you know package managers from the inside, have worked on model compression or edge inference, have robotics experience, or have contributed to open source. None of this is required. What we offer You'll work on problems few people have solved yet, together with the people who created Mamba, Pixi, rattler and RoboStack. Most of your work will be open source and used by a large community from day one. We pay a competitive Berlin salary, with 30 days of vacation, the hardware you want, a conference budget, and time for upstream open source work. We help with relocation within the EU. jobs.description: Diese Aufgaben warten auf Dich Skalierbare Lifecycle-Flows in HubSpot entstehen unter deiner Hand – von Partner-Onboarding bis Churn-Prävention, erweitert um den B2C-Lifecycle unserer Endkund:innen in Whitelabel-Partnerschaften. Du unterstützt bei der Planung partnerbezogener Kommunikation und wirkst an der Budgetplanung mit. Das bringst Du mit Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Retention, Akquise und Lifecycle-Marketing an der Schnittstelle B2B und B2C, mit Hintergrund in CRM, SEO/AEO, Strategie und Start-ups. jobs.title: Senior PR Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Yepoda Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients. Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day. As Senior PR Manager, you will lead Yepoda’s global communications and PR strategy across all markets. Your focus is to elevate brand awareness, ensure consistent messaging, and create impactful stories across media, partners, and internal channels, while driving measurable reach, impressions, and brand impact in every market. Your Tasks Lead and continuously evolve Yepoda’s global PR strategy, messaging, and brand storytelling across all markets and channels. Own PR performance across markets by defining, tracking, and achieving clear KPIs on impressions, reach, and share of voice. Manage and steer international PR agencies, including briefing, performance management, budget control, and negotiation of retainers and fees. Plan, draft, and coordinate press releases, media kits, seeding concepts, PR boxes, and PR activations; track and report on results. Drive PR box concepts and storytelling in close collaboration with the Creative and Influencer Marketing teams. Build and maintain key company facts, press materials, and ensure all press touchpoints remain updated and aligned. Develop communication strategies for sustainability, Pride, giving-back initiatives, and other brand purpose campaigns. Ensure consistent brand tone, messaging, and visual alignment across PR, influencer collaborations, social media, packaging, and retail touchpoints. Collaborate closely with the Trade Marketing Manager on B2B-related PR activities, including retailer partnerships such as Sephora. Your Profile 5+ years of experience in PR, communications, or brand marketing, ideally within beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands. Strong experience working with and managing international PR agencies across multiple markets. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence writing press-ready content. Comfortable owning PR strategy end-to-end and translating it into measurable brand impact. Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects in parallel. Collaborative, calm, and adaptable in a fast-moving scale-up environment. Fluent in English; additional European languages (e.g. German, French, Spanish, or Italian) are highly desirable. What We Offer Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team. Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand. Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks. Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery. We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default. Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going! jobs.title: Data & Analytics Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description: Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One +, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market. Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy. We are looking for a Data & Analytics Manager to lead an international BI and Data Analytics team across EMEA. This hands-on role combines people management, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and end-to-end data project delivery. You will translate business priorities into execution plans, guide technical decisions, unblock the team, and deliver reliable data products for BI, self-service analytics, and AI-enabled use cases. What you'll do Lead, coach, and develop an international BI and Data Analytics team. Build a motivating, accountable, and change-oriented team environment. Model clean, documented datasets in dbt, from staging through to marts. Own tests, documentation, metric definitions, data contracts, and version control workflows. Develop a semantic layer with governed metrics and dimensions. Drive the ongoing adoption of dbt best practices, ensuring models and documentation are consistent, well-structured, and ready for AI-powered analytics. Support team in the diagnosis of source data issues, reconciliation inconsistencies, and establishment of a single source of truth. Support data migration, ELT pipelines, and data platform consolidation. Optimize Snowflake performance, data freshness, and data quality. Own and continuously improve the processes that keep our data platform reliable. Use Python for data checks, automation, and utilities. Partner with BI and business teams to deliver certified datasets, self-service standards, and end-to-end reporting solutions. Translate business needs into scalable data products and governed metrics. Turn business priorities into project plans, identify risks and trade-offs, unblock the team, and drive delivery to completion. Mentor the team on analytics engineering best practices, modern tooling, and AI-assisted development. What you'll bring 3+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, BI Development, Data Engineering, or a related field, including 1+ years of people or team leadership. Expert-level SQL and strong data modeling and architecture skills, including star schemas, semantic layers, governed metrics, data contracts, and ELT pipelines. Hands-on experience building production-grade dbt projects, including staging-to-marts layering, tests, documentation, ownership, and version-control workflows. Snowflake experience, including query performance optimization, data freshness, and quality monitoring. Python skills for data checks, automation, and utilities. Experience with data quality and operations, including testing, monitoring, source-data reconciliation, CI/CD, data cataloging, and cost/performance tuning. Experience creating dbt models and documentation, AI-ready data products, and using AI-assisted development tools. Experience delivering certified datasets, self-service standards, and BI/reporting solutions end-to-end. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a hands-on, entrepreneurial, and problem-solving mindset. A motivational leadership style, positive drive for change, and confidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions. Nice to have Experience with semantic layer tools such as dbt MetricFlow or Snowflake Semantic Views. Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience leading distributed or intern
