jobs.title: Technical Delivery Manager - Munich
jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The Role As a Technical Delivery Manager at Legora, you will play a central role in ensuring customers successfully deploy, integrate, and adopt our AI-native platform. You'll lead end-to-end technical implementations, act as the primary technical point of contact, and shape how seamlessly new customers go live and scale within Legora. What You'll Be Doing Lead integration projects from kickoff through go-live, owning technical documentation, test plans, and rollout execution to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery Serve as the dedicated technical point of contact during implementation and early adoption, including proactive monitoring and regular stakeholder updates through go-live and the post-rollout period Configure and support customer environments including SSO, DMS integrations (iManage, SharePoint, NetDocuments), and API-based connections Provide dedicated post-rollout technical support for enterprise clients, troubleshooting advanced issues and driving high customer satisfaction Coordinate across Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success to align on requirements and ensure a smooth rollout experience Deliver technical training and guidance to customer teams on configuration, workflows, and best practices Feed insights from delivery projects back to product and engineering to improve future implementations Who You Are Proven experience in technical delivery, implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role Strong hands-on experience with SSO, authentication protocols, and enterprise integrations (DMS platforms, APIs) Excellent project management skills with a structured, proactive approach to managing multiple parallel projects Able to translate technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences Strong communicator who builds trusted relationships across customer and internal teams Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment French language proficiency is an advantage, though not a requirement for this role Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: TechnikerIN Elektrotechnik / Nachrichtentechnik (m/w/d) für Kommunikations- und Funktechnik
jobs.description: Sind Sie technikbegeistert und suchen eine spannende Aufgabe, in der Kommunikation wirklich alles bedeutet? Dann werden Sie Teil unseres erfolgreichen Teams am Standort Saarbrücken! Bei SLK sorgen unsere hochqualifizierten Mitarbeitenden in Erfurt und Saarbrücken dafür, dass moderne Sicherheits- und Kommunikationsinfrastrukturlösungen für Behörden, Kommunen und private Unternehmen im Einsatz sind, um Bürgerinnen und Bürgern sowie Einsatz- und Sicherheitskräfte in Notsituationen schnell und zuverlässig Hilfe leisten können. Unsere hochintegrierten Systeme gewährleisten reibungslose Abläufe in Funknetzen – von ortsfesten und mobilen Sende- und Empfangsanlagen über Endgeräte bis hin zu Leitstellen. So unterstützen wir Rettungsdienste, Einsatz- und Sicherheitskräfte optimal im Einsatz. Wenn Sie den technischen Service mitgestalten möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.</h2> <p>We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.</p> <p>This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.</p> <p>We are now looking for a <strong>Backend Engineer (Golang)</strong> to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.</p> <p>This role will be based in <strong>London</strong>, <strong>UK</strong> as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.</p> <h3>What you'll do:</h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.</li> <li>Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.</li> <li>Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.</li> <li>Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.</li> <li>Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. jobs.description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . About the role Solutions Engineers at Axle build the integrations and technical infrastructure that enable our customers to connect distributed energy devices, orchestrate them, and participate in electricity markets. This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. You will work closely with our customers to understand their technical requirements, build integrations, solve complex technical challenges, and help shape our product based on real world feedback. We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions. At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone. Solutions Engineering at Axle looks like Forming a deep understanding of our domain, our platform, and our customers' technical challenges, so you have enough context to execute at speed. Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms. Working closely with customers to troubleshoot technical issues, support implementations, and design scalable solutions. Steering customers towards a more direct launch plan and a better user experience. Collaborating closely with our Product team to turn customer feedback into product improvements. Focus on outcomes rather than process, taking ownership of the quality and impact of the final product you deliver. Manage your own time and support others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, to deliver 80% of the value in 20% of the time Tech stack 🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend 🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility. 🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly ☁️ We deploy on GCP What's in it for you A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity). We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. jobs.description: The Role Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams. This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end. Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French. Responsibilities Clinical assessment and delivery Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required. Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually. Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation. Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires. Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes. Case management and coordination Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure. Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated. Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly. Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving. Clinical risk oversight and governance Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements. Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy. Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention. Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol. Clinical protocols and client enablement Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions. Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English. Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales. Client relationship, insights and reporting Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical. Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes. Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people team

Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils de développement, le versioning et l’analyse de données. jobs.title: Characterization Lead
jobs.description: At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption. Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Daarnaast bieden wij: Uitdagende SAP-projecten binnen de zorg én andere complexe sectoren. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Een internationale SAP-community met honderden experts. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineering
jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren software engineer of architect die inhoudelijk sterk wil blijven, maar ook graag een team verder brengt? Bij adesso Nederland zoeken we een Lead Software Engineering. Iemand die technologie, mensen en delivery bij elkaar brengt. Je bent niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van je team, maar blijft zelf dicht bij de inhoud en onze klanten. Je werkt met ervaren software engineers aan uitdagende klantomgevingen en helpt tegelijkertijd onze Software Engineering-practice verder uit te bouwen. Van Java en moderne frontendtechnologie tot cloud, architectuur en agentic software engineering. Geen rol waarin je alleen maar gaat managen dus. Je blijft onderdeel van het vak. Wat ga je doen? Als Lead Software Engineering geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 5 tot 12 consultants en developers. Je coacht collega's, helpt ze groeien en zorgt ervoor dat zij op projecten zitten die passen bij hun kennis, ervaring en ontwikkeling. Tegelijkertijd ben je betrokken bij onze klanten en projecten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van delivery, denkt mee over architectuur en engineeringvraagstukken en springt bij wanneer een project inhoudelijk of organisatorisch extra aandacht nodig heeft. Je rol bestaat grofweg uit vier onderdelen: People & team Je voert 1-op-1's, begeleidt ontwikkeling en performance en helpt collega's bij hun volgende stap. Je zorgt voor een goede onboarding van nieuwe collega's en bent actief betrokken bij recruitment en selectie. Software Engineering & delivery Je blijft inhoudelijk betrokken bij software engineering en kunt zelf een leidende rol pakken op een technisch of architectuurvraagstuk. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en risico's en zorgt dat onze teams voorspelbaar en professioneel leveren. Tegelijkertijd help je engineers zich ontwikkelen richting Agentic Engineering: minder tijd besteden aan het produceren van code en meer aan het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, het orkestreren van agents en het reviewen en valideren van de output. Klanten & commercie Je ziet wat er bij klanten speelt en vertaalt dat naar kansen voor adesso. Je denkt mee in presales, voorstellen en bids en helpt oplossingen vorm te geven die technisch én commercieel kloppen. Bij bestaande klanten herken je mogelijkheden voor vervolgprojecten en uitbreiding. Daarbij verschuift de focus steeds meer van het leveren van capaciteit naar het realiseren van engineering outcomes: sneller bouwen, moderniseren en klanten helpen hun engineeringorganisatie toekomstbestendig te maken. Groei van onze Software Engineering-practice Je helpt bepalen welke kennis, technologie en capabilities we als team nodig hebben. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen onder andere Java, frontend, cloud, architectuur en Agentic Engineering en vertaalt die naar onze manier van werken. Je helpt daarmee niet alleen individuele engineers groeien, maar bouwt mee aan een schaalbare engineering capability binnen adesso. We zoeken geen klassieke people manager die de techniek inmiddels heeft losgelaten. We zoeken juist iemand die software engineering begrijpt én mensen kan meenemen in de ontwikkeling van het vak. Je hebt ruime ervaring binnen software engineering en hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead Developer of Software Architect. Je hebt ervaring met Java en/of moderne software-architecturen en begrijpt wat nodig is om complexe softwareprojecten succesvol te leveren. Daarnaast: heb je circa 7–8 jaar of meer relevante ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling en complexe projecten; heb je ervaring met het begeleiden, coachen of aansturen van andere engineers; kun je met zowel developers als klanten en management schakelen; begrijp je onderwerpen als delivery, capaciteit, kwaliteit en projectmarge; heb je ervaring binnen consultancy of projectmatige dienstverlening, of voel je je thuis in zo'n omgeving; vind je het interessant om mee te bouwen aan proposities, presales en klantrelaties; volg je ontwikkeling

jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Marketing
jobs.description: Ben jij een creatieve en enthousiaste student die zich wil ontwikkelen in de wereld van marketing en communicatie én waardevolle ervaring wil opdoen binnen een ambitieus team? Wie ben jij Jij bent een creatieve duizendpoot die barst van de ideeën en niet bang is om initiatief te nemen. Je houdt van aanpakken, denkt in mogelijkheden en weet meerdere projecten tegelijk te coördineren. Met jouw organisatietalent en communicatieve skills breng je niet alleen structuur, maar ook energie en gezelligheid in het team. Herken jij jezelf als marketing- en communicatietopper in spé? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen! Wat ga je doen Geen dag is hetzelfde, en dat maakt jouw stage bij ons juist zo leuk en veelzijdig. Je denkt actief mee over de opzet en uitvoering van marketingcampagnes, waarbij jouw frisse blik en creatieve input van grote waarde zijn. Je helpt bij het ontwikkelen van campagnes voor onze leden, creëert pakkende content en werkt mee aan het vormgeven van promotiemateriaal. Ook krijg je de kans om mee te organiseren aan (sponsor)evenementen en ondersteun je collega’s bij het verbeteren van processen en projecten. Kortom: je draait volwaardig mee in het team en krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te laten zien én te groeien. Wat bieden wij Een leerzame en leuke stage binnen een enthousiast en betrokken team. Laat jij initiatief zien? Dan krijg je volop kansen om mee te denken en mee te doen; Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en het beste uit jezelf te halen; Een enthousiast team van ervaren Marketing collega’s; Een stagevergoeding van €600,- per maand (bij 38 uur per week); Minstens twee gezamenlijke kantoordagen per week in Heerenveen met het team. Wie wij zijn Univé Dichtbij is één van de acht regiokantoren binnen Univé. Als coöperatie helpen we mensen zo zorgeloos mogelijk te leven en ondernemen. Dat doen we al meer dan 200 jaar: samen risico’s dragen, zonder winstoogmerk en met oog voor elkaar. We zijn er niet alleen om te verzekeren, maar ook om te voorkomen, adviseren en begeleiden. Juist in een wereld die steeds digitaler en complexer wordt, blijven wij dichtbij: met persoonlijk advies, lokale betrokkenheid en aandacht voor wat mensen echt nodig hebben. Met 24 winkels en 480 collega’s in Utrecht, Gelderland, Drenthe, Overijssel, Flevoland en Friesland zijn we letterlijk in de buurt. Onze winkels zijn vertrouwde plekken voor advies, een goed gesprek en verbinding met de omgeving. Bij Univé Dichtbij draait het om vertrouwen, verbondenheid en samen sterk staan, voor onze leden, voor elkaar en voor de samenleving om ons heen. Overige informatie Interesse? jobs.title: DevOps Engineer Integratie
jobs.description: Wie ben jij Jij bent expert op het gebied van Integratie-oplossingen in Azure en jij vindt het leuk om vanuit jouw IT-expertise bij te dragen aan de Univé doelstellingen. Daarnaast ben je altijd op zoek naar het verbeteren van het eigen Integratie Platform en de Agile werkwijze. Hierbij weet jij als geen ander je technische en communicatieve vaardigheden in te zetten. Dit doe je het liefst in teamverband. jobs.title: Specialist Productontwikkeling particuliere Verzekeringen
jobs.description: Wie ben jij Ben jij een besluitvaardige en energieke professional die met een frisse blik kijkt naar particuliere verzekeringen? Zie jij commerciële kansen voordat anderen ze zien? En krijg jij energie van het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van verzekeringsproducten die aansluiten op het leven van vandaag én morgen? Dan krijg je bij Univé de kans om écht impact te maken. Bij Univé krijg je de ruimte om invloed te hebben op onze particuliere verzekeringen. Je werkt aan producten die relevant zijn op momenten waarop onze leden zekerheid en ondersteuning nodig hebben. Bijvoorbeeld wanneer iemand aansprakelijk wordt gesteld voor schade of juridische hulp nodig heeft bij een conflict. We zoeken geen beheerder, maar iemand die initiatief neemt, kansen ziet en ideeën in beweging brengt. Iemand die commercieel denkt, oog heeft voor de klant én begrijpt dat een goed verzekeringsproduct ook toekomstbestendig en rendabel moet zijn. Jij brengt mee: Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, rechten of vergelijkbaar; Wft Schade Particulier of de bereidheid deze te halen; Ervaring binnen de particuliere verzekeringsmarkt, bijvoorbeeld als productspecialist, acceptant of productontwikkelaar; Je hebt gevoel voor marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften en weet commerciële kansen te herkennen; Je combineert commercieel inzicht met klantgericht denken en weet kansen te vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; Je bent ondernemend, neemt initiatief en durft met nieuwe ideeën te komen; Je krijgt energie van vernieuwen, verbeteren en het daadwerkelijk realiseren van ideeën; Ervaring binnen verzekeringen is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw commerciële mindset, nieuwsgierigheid en vernieuwende ideeën vinden we minstens zo belangrijk; Affiniteit met juridische en maatschappelijke vraagstukken is een pré; Je bent nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden van AI en vindt het leuk om nieuwe technologie, zoals ChatGPT, toe te passen om je werk slimmer en beter te doen; Je hebt gevoel voor stakeholdermanagement en schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende disciplines en belangen; Je bent analytisch en communicatief sterk en werkt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband prettig samen. Wat ga je doen Jij vertaalt klantinzichten, marktontwikkelingen en trends naar onderscheidende verzekeringsproposities. Daarmee help je Univé groeien én zorg je dat onze producten relevant en aantrekkelijk blijven voor onze leden. Je werkt binnen het brede domein van particuliere schadeverzekeringen, met een focus op Rechtsbijstand en de Aansprakelijkheidsverzekering voor Particulieren (AVP). jobs.title: Stage: Marketing Retail en Logistiek
jobs.description: Wat jij doet Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen meekijken, maar echt bijdragen aan commerciële groei, slimme marketing en innovatieve AI-toepassingen? Dan is deze stage bij Centric iets voor jou. Binnen onze divisie Retail & Logistiek werk je mee aan de marketing en positionering van softwareoplossingen voor sectoren zoals retail, bouw en transport. Je komt terecht in een team waar marketing, data en technologie samenkomen en waar jouw ideeën direct impact kunnen maken.Tijdens je stage draai je volledig mee in het team. Je werkt onder andere met Microsoft Dynamics CRM, waarbij je klantdata helpt beheren, analyseren en slimmer inzet voor marketingdoeleinden. Daarnaast ondersteun je bij e-mailcampagnes en klantcommunicatie en help je mee met het creëren en plannen van social media content. Ook denk je mee over campagnes rondom verschillende softwareoplossingen, zoals credit risk, EDI en software voor bouw en transport. Wat deze stage extra interessant maakt, is de ruimte om te experimenteren met AI. Je onderzoekt hoe AI-tools slimmer ingezet kunnen worden binnen marketing en businessprocessen en analyseert campagnes en data om te ontdekken wat werkt en waar kansen liggen. Bij Centric werk je niet aan opdrachten die in een la verdwijnen. Jouw werk wordt daadwerkelijk gebruikt en helpt ons om campagnes effectiever te maken, klantdata beter te benutten en nieuwe commerciële kansen te creëren. Deze stage past goed bij studenten die nieuwsgierig zijn naar de combinatie van marketing, business en data. Volg je een opleiding in Marketing, Communicatie, Commerciële Economie, Bedrijfskunde, Bedrijfseconomie of iets vergelijkbaars? Dan zou dit zomaar jouw ideale stage kunnen zijn. Je krijgt bij ons de kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een innovatieve techomgeving, veel verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en jezelf snel te ontwikkelen. Daarbij krijg je begeleiding van professionals én volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ideeën. Klaar om impact te maken tijdens je stage? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Dit krijg je Een stage waarin je echt meewerkt en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt; Begeleiding van ervaren collega’s; Ruimte om te leren, experimenteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Een stagevergoeding en flexibiliteit (hybride werken); Ervaring binnen een grote softwareorganisatie met veel verschillende business units; Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen. Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen. Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs. Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern. jobs.title: Investment Director (Diagnostics) - Lyon, France
jobs.description: Location : Lyon, France ABOUT ARCHIMED With offices in Europe, the US and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare. Our mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise positions us as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Priority areas include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages $11 billion across its funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based GP. MED I, MED II and MED Platform I are all top-decile performers for their vintage according to Preqin data. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation. THE TEAM An global team with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines. Alumni of INSEAD, Wharton, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others. Professional backgrounds spanning Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, Capiton, Partners Group, KKR), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Jefferies) and Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Stryker, Phillips, Pfizer, Baxter, LivaNova, J&J, Galderma, Sanofi). THE DIAGNOSTICS TEAM The Director will serve as a senior investment professional with direct responsibility for sourcing, evaluating and executing investments across the Diagnostics portfolio. The Director will lead deal activity across an assigned geography, technology platform or investment theme, and will carry accountability for investment outcomes, value creation and portfolio company support. This is a senior operating role combining strategic direction setting with hands-on deal execution, positioning the Director as a trusted senior advisor to Partners and portfolio management teams. Investment Sourcing & Strategy Drive sourcing and pipeline development across assigned Diagnostics sectors or geographies, identifying and cultivating relationships with sellers, intermediaries and LP co-investors. Lead the formation and evolution of investment theses within assigned focus areas, including category mapping, competitive positioning and market trend analysis. Serve as primary investment decision maker and deal sponsor, with direct accountability for investment committee presentations and recommendation. Lead the negotiation of transaction terms, pricing and deal structure in partnership with Partners and external advisors. Due Diligence & Execution Oversee comprehensive commercial, financial and operational due diligence, working with external advisors to validate assumptions and identify key risks and levers. Lead the development of post-acquisition value creation roadmaps, including 100-day plans and multi-year operating strategies. Manage the investment committee approval process and coordinate all transaction closing mechanics with legal and finance teams. Portfolio Leadership & Value Creation Serve as the primary investment relationship owner for assigned portfolio companies, working directly with management teams on strategy, M&A, capital deployment and operational priorities. Lead add-on acquisition identification, evaluation and execution, including syndication with co-investors. Drive performance monitoring and problem-solving, escalating key decisions to Partners and intervention areas to senior management. Sponsor and mentor portfolio company boards, ensuring robust governance and strategic clarity. Team & Platform Development Mentor and develop Senior Analysts and Associate-level team members, contributing to talent development and succession planning within the Diagnostics function. Contribute t

jobs.title: Bauleiter:in (Neubau & Revitalisierung)
jobs.description: BAULEITER:IN (NEUBAU & REVITALISIERUNG) Einsatzgebiet: Münster (+50 km) & Düsseldorf (+100 km) Du bringst fundierte Bauerfahrung mit und möchtest Deine Expertise dort einsetzen, wo sie Wirkung entfaltet? Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich. Wir entwickeln Immobilien mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz: Seniorenwohnen, Pflegeimmobilien und neue Konzepte für das Wohnen & Leben im Alter. Unser Anspruch: Wir wollen das Wohnen und Leben im Alter maßgeblich verändern. Wir entwickeln neue Wohnformen von Tiny Living bis urbanem Wohnen – vom ländlichen Konzept für das Mittelstand bis zur gehobenen urbanen Wohnanlage. Wir bauen auf dem Land und in der Stadt, neu und im Bestand, und schaffen bezahlbare Wohnangebote mit Service und Betreuung für die Mitte der Gesellschaft. Dafür gehen wir neue Wege und denken Prozesse und Verfahren neu: vom modularen Bauen über Standardisierung und Individualisierung bis zur Skalierung – unter Einsatz neuester Technologien. Dafür suchen wir Dich: Bauleiter:in (m/w/d) Eine Persönlichkeit, die die technische Verantwortung übernimmt: neue Bauweisen versteht, fundiert bewertet und auf der Baustelle umsetzt – im Neubau wie im Bestand, in einem jungen, agilen und digital arbeitenden Team. Wir bauen zukunftsorientiert – agil, digital und effizient. Wenn Du Bauprozesse weiterentwickeln und digitale Werkzeuge konsequent einsetzen möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Deine Rolle: Technische Verantwortung für Neubau- und Revitalisierungsprojekte – vom ersten Spatenstich bis zur Übergabe Technische Bewertung neuer Bauweisen, Systeme und Technologien – vom modularen bis zum seriellen Bauen Mitwirkung an einheitlichen technischen Standards (z. B. wiederkehrende Grundrisse, Bauteile und Ausstattungen), die wir an vielen Standorten umsetzen Steuerung von Ausschreibung und Bauausführung inkl. Koordination der Gewerke und Nachunternehmer Technische Prüfung von Bestandsimmobilien auf bauliche Machbarkeit – als Grundlage für die Projektentwicklung Sicherstellung von Qualität, Kosten und Terminen auf der Baustelle – in enger Abstimmung mit der Projektentwicklung Digitale Baustelle: Bautagebuch, Mängel- und Terminmanagement – papierlos und datenbasiert Was uns wichtig ist: Wir suchen keinen klassischen Konzern-Bauleiter. Wir suchen Menschen mit Ambition, Gestaltungswillen und Umsetzungsstärke, die: fundierte Erfahrung in Neubau und Bauen im Bestand mitbringen (Umbau, Sanierung, Revitalisierung) Erfahrung mit modularem und seriellem Bauen bzw. Sanieren haben – oder dieses Thema aktiv in Projekte einbringen möchten digitale Lösungen im Bau schätzen und Bauprozesse moderner, effizienter und datenbasiert gestalten wollen Projekte auch in komplexen Situationen zielsicher zum Abschluss bringen Entscheidungen treffen und Verantwortung übernehmen sich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln möchten Prozesse aktiv gestalten, statt sie nur zu verwalten Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen Macher mit Baustellenerfahrung, die Lust auf ein junges, ambitioniertes Team haben. B. als Bauingenieur, Bautechniker oder Meister Erfahrung mit Neubauten ebenso wie mit komplexen Umbauten im Bestand Technisches Verständnis für modulare, serielle und digitale Bauweisen – und die Fähigkeit, sie fundiert zu bewerten Erfahrung mit Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Abrechnung (VOB) Unternehmerisches Denken und lösungsorientiertes Handeln Kommunikationsstärke im Umgang mit allen Projektbeteiligten Bestehendes Netzwerk zu Architekten, Fachplanern, Generalunternehmern und Behörden von Vorteil Begeisterung für das Thema Wohnen & Leben im Alter Bereitschaft zum Einsatz an unseren Hauptstandorten: Münster und Umgebung (ca. 50 km) sowie Düsseldorf und Umgebung (ca. 100 km) Das bieten wir Dir: Projekte mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz – im Neubau wie im Bestand Großer Gestaltungsspielraum statt starrer Konzernstrukturen Ein junges, leistungsorient

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a  Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly! Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use. Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems. This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data. What you will do Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption. Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration. Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code. Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products. Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution. Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery. Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes. Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations. What we are looking for Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments. Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes. Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance. Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more. Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows. Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership. Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty. Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards,

jobs.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.</h2> <p>We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.</p> <p>This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.</p> <p>We are now looking for a <strong>Backend Engineer (Golang)</strong> to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.</p> <p>This role will be based in <strong>London</strong>, <strong>UK</strong> as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.</p> <h3>What you'll do:</h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.</li> <li>Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.</li> <li>Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.</li> <li>Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.</li> <li>Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.</li> <li>Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.</li> <li>Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.</li> </ul> <h2>Our expectations:</h2> <ul> <li>3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.</li> <li>1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.</li> <li>A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput dis

jobs.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. As our first dedicated Staff Software Engineer for Storage Platform, you’ll set the technical direction for how we manage, protect and serve this data. Working closely with Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Data Engineering and ML teams, you’ll help make training more efficient while reducing one of Wayve’s largest infrastructure costs. 🧠 Your day-to-day Lead a hands-on, multi-quarter storage programme, from defining the problems and architecture to delivering platforms that teams adopt. Build production services, controllers and infrastructure using Python, Go or a similar language, alongside Kubernetes and Terraform. Partner with ML and data teams to understand access patterns, remove storage bottlenecks and reduce the time GPUs spend waiting for data. Work with Security and Privacy to strengthen access controls, auditing and safe deletion of vehicle-collected data. Write design documents and RFCs, align teams around shared standards, and mentor engineers as the platform and team grow. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Data ownership and governance: Give datasets clear owners, purposes and retention classes, with tagging and team-level cost attribution. Safe lifecycle management: Build retention, deletion and re-tiering capabilities for Azure Blob, backed by dry runs, audit trails and recovery paths. Read performance and caching: Improve throughput and latency by tackling small-object reads, throttling, unnecessary data access and cross-region hops. Secure data movement: Design Kubernetes-native NVMe caching and secure replication across regions and clouds. Measurable platform outcomes: Establish standards, dashboards and SLOs for availability, performance, cache effectiveness, storage tiers and cost. 🙌 You should apply if You’ve operated at Staff Engineer scope, leading complex infrastructure programmes across multiple teams from problem definition through adoption. You’ve owned petabyte-scale object storage end to end—including data layout, lifecycle management, performance and cost—with measurable outcomes against a cost target. You’ve built scalable systems for data ownership, tagging, cataloguing, retention or deletion. You bring strong security and access-management experience, including IAM/RBAC, encryption, secure replication and auditing. You’re a hands-on software engineer with strong Python, Go or comparable skills, plus production Kubernetes, Terraform and CI experience. You build durable platforms and services, not just one-off scripts. You can influence technical decisions without formal authority, mentor others and are excited to start in a founding, hands-on role with the opportunity to grow a team. You can work on a hybrid basis from our London office. Experience with AWS or GCP is welcome—you don’t need to have worked exclusively with Azure. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions. At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone. Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms. En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route. Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp. Vos missions Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes. Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp. Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels. Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat. Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp. Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits. Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain. Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes. Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux. Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Proposer des améliorations pertinentes sur notre code, nos outils et nos pratiques. Contribuer régulièrement aux revues de code et respecter les standards de qualité de l’équipe. 🎯 Objectif : être opérationnel·le sur notre stack et capable de livrer de manière autonome

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver. The Role As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow. You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span: Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads. Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own. jobs.title: Solution Consultant - R&D
jobs.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies. The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers. jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. Wat neem jij mee? Je bent sociaal, resultaatgericht en een goede luisteraar, met het vermogen om helder en bondig te communiceren. Daarnaast draagt iedere medewerker actief bij aan de behoeften van de klant. jobs.title: Senior Information Security Officer (ISO)
jobs.description: Wil jij zorgorganisaties helpen om informatiebeveiliging structureel en praktisch op orde te brengen? Werk je graag op het snijvlak van IT, processen en dagelijkse praktijk, en vind je het belangrijk dat informatiebeveiliging niet alleen een norm is, maar daadwerkelijk wordt toegepast? Dan is deze rol als Information Security Officer (ISO) iets voor jou.   Als ISO ben je verantwoordelijk voor het operationeel bewaken en verbeteren van informatiebeveiliging bij klanten van Beter Healthcare. Je vertaalt risico’s en beveiligingsmaatregelen naar concrete acties en zorgt ervoor dat deze effectief worden toegepast. Je werkt nauw samen met IT, privacy, management en de business om informatiebeveiliging integraal in de dagelijkse praktijk te verankeren.   Je beweegt je comfortabel tussen analyse en uitvoering: van risico-inventarisaties en beleid tot het ondersteunen bij audits en het vergroten van bewustwording binnen de organisatie. Je bent een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor informatiebeveiliging en weet overzicht te houden in een dynamische omgeving.   Wat jij gaat doen Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en vertalen van risico’s naar passende beheersmaatregelen; Ondersteunen bij audits en certificeringstrajecten (bijvoorbeeld ISO 27001 en/of NEN-normen); Monitoren van de naleving van informatiebeveiligingsmaatregelen en hierover rapporteren aan de CISO; Vergroten van security awareness binnen de organisatie, onder andere door voorlichting en kennisdeling; Adviseren en ondersteunen van teams bij praktische informatiebeveiligingsvraagstukken.   Elke opdracht is anders, dat vraagt om flexibiliteit en nieuwsgierigheid. Je werkt op verschillende locaties bij de klant door heel Nederland, soms vanuit huis, en soms op een van onze kantoorlocaties. Je krijgt de ruimte om je werk op een manier in te richten die past bij jou én de organisatie. Wie jij bent Je bent een informatiebeveiligingsprofessional met enkele jaren ervaring, die zijn of haar vak goed verstaat en dit graag verder wil verdiepen. Je werkt gestructureerd en zorgvuldig en hebt een duidelijke focus op kwaliteit. Je vindt het belangrijk dat beleid, procedures en maatregelen niet alleen correct zijn vastgelegd, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar zijn en aansluiten bij de organisatie.   Je hebt goed inzicht in processen en informatiestromen en begrijpt hoe risico’s ontstaan binnen een organisatie. Je analyseert deze risico’s zorgvuldig en weet ze, samen met collega’s en stakeholders, te vertalen naar passende en realistische maatregelen. Daarbij weet je hoofd- en bijzaken goed te scheiden en behoud je overzicht, ook wanneer meerdere onderwerpen tegelijkertijd spelen.   Je staat open voor vernieuwing en denkt actief mee over verbeteringen. Met jouw innoverend vermogen zoek je naar manieren om informatiebeveiliging slimmer, effectiever en toekomstbestendig in te richten, passend bij de context en volwassenheid van de organisatie. Daarnaast haal je energie uit het delen van kennis. Je begrijpt dat informatiebeveiliging pas echt werkt wanneer collega’s weten wat er van hen wordt verwacht en waarom dat belangrijk is. Je weet complexe materie helder en begrijpelijk over te brengen en draagt actief bij aan het vergroten van security awareness binnen de organisatie.   In de samenwerking ben je toegankelijk en professioneel. Je communiceert duidelijk, onderbouwt je adviezen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming of opschaling nodig is.   Ervaring & expertise Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een rol op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, bijvoorbeeld als Information Security Officer, security officer, adviseur of vergelijkbaar; Ervaring binnen de zorg sector of binnen soortgelijke sectoren zoals (semi-)overheid en/of financial services Ervaring met het opstellen, implementeren en onderhouden van informatiebeveiligingsbeleid en -procedures; Basis tot goede kennis van relevante normen en kaders, zoals ISO 27001 en/of NEN 7510, 7512, 7

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description: Wil jij zorgorganisaties helpen om informatiebeveiliging en privacy structureel naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Werk je graag op het snijvlak van strategie, governance en uitvoering, in een sector waar vertrouwen en veiligheid essentieel zijn? Dan is deze rol als Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) iets voor jou.   Als CISO ondersteun je klanten van Beter Healthcare bij het versterken en professionaliseren van hun informatiebeveiliging en privacystrategie. Je werkt aan zowel strategische als operationele vraagstukken en helpt organisaties bij het inrichten, verbeteren en borgen van hun informatiebeveiligingsbeleid en -processen. Als consultant vervul je tijdelijk de rol van CISO en treed je op als strategisch adviseur voor bestuur en management.   Je werkt aan uiteenlopende opdrachten, zoals het opstellen en herzien van informatiebeveiligingsbeleid, het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses, het implementeren van NEN- en ISO-normen en het begeleiden van audits en certificeringstrajecten. Daarbij ben je de verbindende schakel tussen bestuur, management, IT en de zorgpraktijk.   Wat jij gaat doen Adviseren van zorgorganisaties over informatiebeveiliging en privacy, met focus op strategie en governance; Tijdelijk invullen van de CISO-rol of optreden als strategisch sparringpartner voor bestuur en directie; Opstellen en verbeteren van informatiebeveiligingsbeleid kaders en -processen; Begeleiden van audits en certificeringstrajecten (o.a. NEN 7510, ISO 27001) vanuit strategisch perspectief; Ondersteunen bij naleving van wet- en regelgeving zoals AVG en NIS2 op strategisch niveau; Vergroten van bewustzijn en commitment op bestuursniveau voor informatiebeveiliging en privacy.   Elke opdracht is anders, dat vraagt om flexibiliteit en nieuwsgierigheid. Je werkt op verschillende locaties bij de klant door heel Nederland, soms vanuit huis, en soms op een van onze kantoorlocaties. Je krijgt de ruimte om je werk op een manier in te richten die past bij jou én de organisatie. Wie jij bent Je bent een ervaren CISO die zich comfortabel voelt in complexe omgevingen waar informatiebeveiliging, wet- en regelgeving en organisatiebelangen samenkomen. Je neemt van nature het voortouw en weet richting te geven, zonder de verbinding met mensen en de praktijk te verliezen. In jouw rol combineer je overzicht met daadkracht en weet je organisaties stap voor stap verder te helpen in het versterken van hun informatiebeveiliging.   Je doorgrondt snel hoe een zorgorganisatie in elkaar zit en hebt oog voor zowel de formele structuren als de onderliggende dynamiek. Daardoor weet je belangen goed af te wegen en je aanpak af te stemmen op de context waarin je werkt. Of je nu schakelt met bestuurders, management, ICT of zorgprofessionals: je communiceert helder, overtuigend en met gevoel voor de doelgroep, en weet complexe securityvraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken. Inhoudelijk weet je snel tot de kern te komen. Je analyseert risico’s en kwetsbaarheden zorgvuldig en vertaalt deze naar concrete, passende maatregelen. Je werkt gestructureerd, onderbouwt je adviezen en behoudt overzicht, ook wanneer meerdere thema’s of belangen tegelijkertijd spelen.   Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan de korte termijn. Je begrijpt hoe informatiebeveiliging bijdraagt aan de strategische doelstellingen van een organisatie en helpt bij het maken van keuzes die ook op de lange termijn houdbaar zijn. Je weet strategie te verbinden aan uitvoering en draagt bij aan duurzame borging van informatiebeveiliging binnen de organisatie.   Ervaring& expertise Ruime ervaring (5+) als consultant, adviseur of CISO op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, bij voorkeur binnen zorg of overheid; Aantoonbare ervaring met het inrichten en verbeteren van informatiebeveiligingsprocessen; Grondige kennis van NEN 7510, ISO 27001; Ervaring met risicoanalyses, audits en certificeringstrajecten; Een CISM-opleiding of vergelijkbare certificering is een pré.   Wat je van

Digitalisering, data en AI bieden daarbij grote kansen, maar alleen als technologie aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk van schadebehandeling. In deze rol werk je aan uiteenlopende opdrachten bij verzekeraars en opereer je op het snijvlak van business, processen en IT. Je gebruikt jouw ervaring uit de schadepraktijk om complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden en te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen. Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het Symbria -platform. Workshops & Stakeholdermanagement Begeleiden van workshops en werksessies bij verzekeraars. Ophalen en structureren van wensen en behoeften van verschillende stakeholders. Schakelen tussen schadebehandelaars, managers, product owners, consultants en softwareontwikkelaars. Complexe inhoud begrijpelijk maken voor verschillende doelgroepen. Creëren van draagvlak voor nieuwe processen, werkwijzen en technologische oplossingen. Technologie, Data & AI Onderzoeken hoe technologie het schadeproces slimmer en efficiënter kan maken. Meedenken over toepassingen van AI en automatisering binnen schadebehandeling. Identificeren van kansen om repetitieve werkzaamheden te automatiseren. Samenwerken met product- en developmentteams om oplossingen vanuit de praktijk vorm te geven. Bijdragen aan de verdere digitalisering van de schadeverzekeringsketen. Thought Leadership & Marktontwikkeling Inbrengen van jouw inhoudelijke expertise in klantvraagstukken en proposities. Ontwikkelen van visie op de toekomst van schadebehandeling. Bijdragen aan thought leadership binnen het schadevak. Signaleren van ontwikkelingen en innovaties die relevant zijn voor verzekeraars. Samen met collega's verder bouwen aan de positie van IG&H binnen de schadeverzekeringsmarkt. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring & Experti

jobs.description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The role We're hiring a Data Analyst to work as close as possible to the teams that run RevenueCat's business, including Marketing, Sales, Finance, People, Ops, Product, etc. The most valuable thing on our Analytics team today isn't SQL, it's domain knowledge. Knowing what a trial start actually counts, why tracked revenue and realized revenue are different, how store refunds land in our data, and which model answers a question correctly the first time. That knowledge is what turns a half-formed Slack question into a number someone can act on within the hour. So you'll spend most of your time with business teams: understanding what they're trying to decide, turning vague questions into analysis, and shipping the datasets and dashboards they rely on. You'll build that domain knowledge fast, working day to day with the person who currently owns Analytics here. He'll be your closest partner and the person who helps you grow into the domain. The second thing that makes this role exciting is how we expect you to work. We're building the infrastructure that lets AI agents access our data safely, and agentic tooling that answers questions grounded in our semantic layer rather than guessing. You'll be one of its heaviest users and one of the people who makes it trustworthy: curating the semantic context, catching the answers that look right and aren't, and pushing definitions back into dbt and LookML where they belong. We're not hiring someone to do the same volume of work faster, we're hiring someone who supports multiple teams well using this collection of new tools as a force multiplier. What you will do Partner regularly with Marketing, Sales, Finance and Product teams. Learn their goals, their metrics, and the decisions they're actually stuck on. Own analysis end to end: clarify the real question, build or pick the right dataset, deliver the answer, and make sure a decision follows. Go deep on our subscription domain, then write it down. Metric definitions, caveats, always-filters, known gotchas. Domain knowledge that only lives in your head doesn't scale, and scaling it is the point of this role. Build analytics assets people trust without asking you first: models in dbt, explores in LookML, dashboards that hold up. Use our agent tooling as a force multiplier and contribute back to it. Feed it semantic context, flag wrong answers, harden the definitions it depends on. Contribute to the data platform where it unblocks you. Small model and pipeline improvements, debugging discrepancies, helping out when something breaks. Translate in both directions: business context into robust analysis, data reality into language a non-technical stakeholder can act on. About you 3+ years in an analytics role (Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst, Analytics Engineer or similar), including real experience as the direct analytics partner to a business team such as Marketing, Sales or Finance. Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together. As part of a small product team you will have full ownership over your domain, so you should be a person who dreams big, then executes well. At Thumbtack, the Applied Science team is responsible for a wide variety of problems spanning AI, machine learning, statistics, and computer science: Improve customer and service provider matching. Matching and optimization algorithms are fundamental to Thumbtack’s product: we now service millions of matches per week. Identifying better matches between customers and service providers has an incredible impact on the experience of customers and professionals transacting on our platform. As an Applied Scientist on Pro Growth, you’ll build models and experiments that shape who joins Thumbtack, how they get activated, how we forecast supply needs by market and trade, and how we accelerate time-to-value for new pros. We leverage machine learning, causal inference, and optimization to strategically grow and shape our pro supply base. Our work directly contributes to meeting demand projections, unlocking strategic partnerships, and ultimately enhancing customer experience and platform growth by ensuring a robust and high-quality supply of pros. You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, product managers, and other applied scientists on a portfolio that ranges from incrementality and market forecasting to LLM-powered onboarding agents. You’ll own end-to-end: from problem framing, through experiment design, through deploying models to production, through measuring business impact. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Position Summary ExtraHop is at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, delivering Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions that help organizations detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats in real time. Join ExtraHop as a Senior Data Scientist and help advance the machine learning and artificial intelligence capabilities that power our products. You will analyze large-scale network telemetry, develop and evaluate methods for identifying malicious behavior, and improve the accuracy and efficacy of ExtraHop’s threat detection capabilities. Experience working with incomplete, noisy, or highly imbalanced data; performing detailed error analysis; and identifying the causes of false positives and false negatives. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with common data science and machine learning libraries, and the ability to write maintainable, tested, and reviewable code. Experience collaborating with software engineers to integrate data science methods into production systems. Strong problem-solving skills,

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Personalization & Predictions
jobs.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. You'd be joining the Artificial Intelligence team . We own the algorithmic core of the platform: Predictions, Contextual Personalization, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, and the agentic workflows behind Loomi. We work with behavioural data at terabyte scale, across 1,400+ customers, in production, every day. We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region (Central & Eastern Europe) or we are happy to meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis. The mission You find the signal in how 1,400 brands' customers actually behave — and you prove it moved a business metric. Your models decide which customers are predicted to churn, which segments form themselves, which offer a shopper sees, and whether the discount changed anything or was going to convert anyway. What you'll actually do Frame the problem before modelling it. Most of our highest-impact work arrives as a vague business question, and turning it into something measurable is the first job. Work the data at scale. Behavioural data, product catalogues and event streams across BigQuery and Databricks — finding features that carry real predictive signal, not the ones that are easy to compute. Build and evaluate models across Predictions and Contextual Personalization: propensity and churn, contextual bandits, autosegmentation, uplift and incrementality. Design the evaluation, not just the model. Offline metrics, backtests, and the A/B design that decides whether this ships. You own the question "how would we know if this is worse?" Bring methods in from outside and judge them honestly — read the literature, run the quick PoC, and tell a real result from a well-marketed one. Hand off cleanly to ML Engineering. You own the model and the evidence; they own making it survive production. That handoff is a document and a conversation, not a notebook over a wall. Explain your results to people who aren't data scientists — Product, Engineering leadership, and sometimes customers. What success looks like after 12 months Two models you built are in production and you can name the business metric each one moved. A question the team was arguing about is settled, with evidence, and your writeup is what people link to. ML Engineering describes your handoffs as easy. ML product engineering — you own an ML-powered feature end to end and the ML part is what makes it interesting. Platform & MLOps — pipelines, serving, deployment, observability, inference cost. jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones . Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides. This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content. Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative. Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights. Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience. Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls. Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process. Job Requirements Successful candidates must: Have substantial professional writing experience , with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.
