Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills. Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time. Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts. Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics. Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story. jobs.title: Phone Sales Agent - Restock
jobs.description: Phone Sales Agent, Restock: We are seeking a motivated and dedicated Phone Sales Agent to join our Restock team. In this role, you’ll reach out to loyal customers who are running low on the products they already know and love, and help them reorder before they run out. These are warm conversations with people who have already bought from us and already like what we sell. You’re not cold calling. You’re the person who calls at exactly the right moment, makes reordering easy, and keeps their routine uninterrupted. This is a base pay + commission position with uncapped earning potential, making it perfect for individuals who thrive in a performance-driven environment. What You’ll Do: Call, text, and email existing customers whose supply is running low, and secure the reorder before they run out. Work an assigned queue of reorder opportunities daily, following the established call and follow-up cadence. Review each customer’s purchase history and order details before you dial, so every conversation is accurate and personalized. Recommend the right product and the right quantity based on where the customer is in their routine. Introduce complementary products that pair well with what the customer already uses, and grow the value of every order. Follow up persistently and professionally across phone, SMS, and email to keep customers engaged and drive conversion. Build rapport with repeat customers so they look forward to hearing from you. Maintain accurate records of every customer interaction and sales activity in our CRM. Meet or exceed individual sales targets on a weekly and monthly basis. What You Bring to The Table: Strong work ethic and self-motivation to drive sales results. Comfort and proficiency with manual dialing and reaching out to leads. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage customers via phone, email, and text. Comfort working inside a CRM and order management system, with strong attention to detail on customer records. A consultative approach, with the instinct to listen first and sell second. A positive attitude and a passion for sales. Ability to work independently and handle rejection with resilience. Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Prior experience in phone sales or telemarketing is a plus, but not required. Technical Must Have’s: We require a stable internet connection (50+mbps Up & down)capable of supporting seamless voice and zoom communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater ( https://chromium.github.io/octane/ ). A backup system for power and internet. A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with working camera, and a working noise-cancelling headset. You will be on Zoom with your team throughout the day. Compensation: Base pay 4+% commission on sales revenue (minus refunds). Your commission rate tiers up as you hit higher performance levels, so top producers earn a higher percentage on the same revenue. Uncapped earning potential Weekly and monthly performance bonuses, including top average order value, top weekly sales, QA excellence, and perfect attendance. Schedule: Full time (35-45 hrs per week) Schedules vary between 9:00am and 7:00pm CT Must be available to work weekends Department Outbound Sales Locations Multiple locations Remote status Fully Remote

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Emerging Products (0-1)
jobs.description: Why you should join us Jerry .ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth. About this role We’re at an inflection point in our journey. After 2 years of profitable growth with a stable core business (car insurance marketplace), we’re ready to expand our product offerings and accelerate customer growth. We’re looking for 2-3 Product Managers to drive progress across one of our key new product bets, including motorcycle insurance (just launched), home insurance (also just launched), new insurance products for other assets like boat and RV (concept phase), as well as non-insurance products to make car and home ownership easier such as helping customers save money on their property taxes (about to launch). Each of these new product areas comes with its own operational complexity, its own customer personas and painpoints, and its own path to scale. And we’re looking for builders who are excited to take ownership of one of these new bets. Why you will (or won't) like working here 0-to-1 scope: The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out. Product complexity: Property tax rules vary county by county. Specialty vehicle insurance involves regulatory and product complexity that doesn't exist in standard auto. These are not clean, well-scoped problems to solve. Real impact: You will have meaningful ownership. And what you do will likely materially impact the trajectory of our business over the next few years. What you'll own There are several new product bets in the motion. The specific product you will work on will largely depend on your prior experience, interests/preferences, and our business priorities when you join the team. The goal in every case remains the same: ramp quickly on a new domain, distill data and insights to identify the highest leverage areas to prioritize (including quantitative data from our Data Science team and qualitative data from our Customer Insights & Research team), build and ship new products, get customer feedback quickly, apply learnings and iterate, and compound on what works. Whether it’s home, motorcycle, boat or RV products, you will be a key contributor to our product roadmap and own execution from early concept or early launch to finding product-market fit, and scaling. Who you are A first-principles thinker: You approach problems with curiosity and use data to develop clear hypotheses before you reach for a solution. You're analytically strong but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?" An owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane. Empathetic & Curious: You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave. Diligent: Your follow through is impeccable. When you own something, nothing falls through the cracks. What you bring 5+ years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), consumer-facing product management, or equivalent role at a high-growth startup Consumer product instincts, either from direct product building experience or from close work alongside consumer product teams Comfort with data: able to run your own analysis and build conviction from messy signals While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted. Please note: Jerry .ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV,

jobs.description: Position overview SNV is building a catalytic commercial accelerator, built to close the gap between capital and impact in markets where both are urgently needed. The Senior Manager for Impact and Intelligence is the intellectual engine within the unit. This role has two distinct but connected responsibilities: delivering client-facing impact measurement as a billable service, and synthesising knowledge across the portfolio to build a body of evidence that sharpens our offer and strengthens our market position. This is not a back-office role. Impact measurement is a revenue line in its own right — impact investors, DFIs, and corporations with sustainability commitments are increasingly willing to pay for rigorous, credible measurement of their programmes. The right person combines analytical rigour with commercial awareness, and understands that evidence is only valuable if it changes decisions. SNV holds a significant body of institutional knowledge — proposals, evaluations, programme data, sector evidence — accumulated across 50+ years and 25+ countries. Most of it is inaccessible or underused. This role is responsible for changing that: activating SNV ’s knowledge base as a commercial asset, not just an archive. Who you are You are a curious and analytical professional who enjoys uncovering insights that help organisations make better decisions. You look beyond the data to understand what is happening, why it matters, and how evidence can be translated into practical action and measurable results. You combine analytical rigour with commercial awareness. You understand that research, impact measurement, and intelligence create value when they influence strategy, strengthen client relationships, support business growth, or improve development outcomes. You are comfortable working with both quantitative and qualitative data and know when deep analysis is required and when a pragmatic, timely recommendation is the better solution. You are collaborative, proactive, and enjoy working across disciplines, bringing together perspectives from colleagues, clients, and partners. When you identify important trends, insights, or opportunities, you share them and help others act on them. Most importantly, you are excited by the opportunity to turn evidence into impact. You identify insights that can be leveraged across the organisation, helping shape new approaches, strengthen market positioning, and inform business development decisions. You are equally motivated by building knowledge systems and intelligence mechanisms that support better future decision-making, reducing uncertainty through the effective use of data, intelligence, and learning. Key Responsibilities Client-facing impact measurement Design and deliver impact measurement frameworks for clients — impact investors, blended finance facilities, agribusinesses, and government counterparts. Develop results chains, theories of change, and indicator sets for IDF and ICVC engagements where measurement is part of the scope. Conduct primary and secondary data collection, analysis, and reporting to investor-grade standards. Package measurement outputs as standalone deliverables — not appendices to strategy documents. Identify and convert standalone measurement mandates: fund impact reporting, programme evaluations, baseline and endline studies. Stay current with impact measurement standards — IRIS+, IMP, GIIRS, and equivalents — and advise clients on which frameworks fit their reporting requirements. Cross-portfolio intelligence Synthesise findings and evidence across all Accelerator engagements into consolidated intelligence: what is working, for whom, at what cost, and under what conditions. Build and maintain a knowledge base that captures reusable assets — frameworks, datasets, case studies, and sector-specific evidence — from every completed engagement. Develop existing partners into producing partners through seller and SE enablement, joint business planning, co-marketing and demand-generation coordination, and accountability to mutually agreed targets; diagnose why partners are not selling and fix it. Own distributor relationships and economics, including transactional flow, margin, and incentive structures, and using distributor reach to extend partner recruitment without CIQ carrying all the overhead. Define and run the program mechanics: partner tiers, deal registration, the margin model, enablement, and the metrics that govern them. Work cross-functionally with direct sales (to manage channel conflict and run co-sell), marketing (partner demand generation), and product (to feed partner and market signal back). Carry and forecast a channel-sourced and influenced pipeline contribution. NEEDED TO SUCCEED Successful candidates will have: A genuine self-starter mindset, comfortable operating with ambiguity, and a near-blank slate. Strong commercial instincts, with the ability to negotiate partner economics and defend margin. Credibility with both partner executives and partner field reps. The discipline to run their book on numbers, not relationships alone. A hands-on operator’s approach, doing the work directly (outreach, partner conversations, enablement sessions, negotiations) rather than delegating it. A friendly, collaborative, humble, honest, and always striving to be better attitude. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience. 8+ years of experience in channel, partner, or alliances sales, ideally in infrastructure, open source, or enterprise software. A track record of personally building partner relationships that produced real revenue (not solely managing a team that did). Experience standing up or materially growing partner program mechanics: tiering, deal registration, margin models, and enablement. BENEFITS Medical, dental, and vision insurance. Flexible paid time off. Employee stock options. Remote work; no travel required for most positions. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: 【短期项目合作远程办公】AI 前沿工程/AI产品搭建
jobs.description: 【AI 前沿工程 AI Frontier Engineer（项目制）】 岗位背景： 公司的日常工作已大量使用 AI。团队使用自主开发的办公产品原型协作，各类工作材料在 AI 辅助下完成，中后台流程正在改为由 AI 驱动。 本岗位不设固定分工，可以自主选择工作重点，持续跟踪全球 AI 前沿的开源项目与企业协作方案，找出适合公司的新能力，快速做成可用的工具推广给全体同事，带动公司整体的 AI 应用水平

jobs.title: 招募前端（暂满）/鸿蒙工程师（在招）兼职出题
